fields.Name: T185 - Committee Memberships Drilldown
fields.Description: Verifies a Committee's full record form exposes a related Committee Memberships section that renders related rows or a valid empty-state.

InputDefinition.goal: Open the 'Committees' entity via the left sidebar 'Search entities...' box: click the search box, type 'Committees', then click the exact 'Committees' node in the results (do NOT expand the entity group/chevron). Open a committee record's full form (click a row, then click 'Open Full Record'). Scroll down to the form's related-records sections and open the 'Committee Memberships' related section. Verify it shows related rows OR a valid empty-state (the related section being present and rendering is success). Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment - wait patiently, do not navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: A Committee full record form is open showing committee detail fields
The related 'Committee Memberships' section is present and rendering - showing membership rows OR a valid empty-state
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
